program.code:
def forward(groups):
    date = groups[0]  # e.g., '081109'
    time = groups[1]  # e.g., '203521'
    seq = int(groups[2])  # e.g., 145
    timestamp = int(datetime.strptime(date + time, '%y%m%d%H%M%S').timestamp() * 1000)
    return {'stored': [timestamp + seq], 'layout': []}

def inverse(record):
    value = record['stored'][0]
    seq = value % 1000
    timestamp = value - seq
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp / 1000)
    date_time_str = dt.strftime('%y%m%d %H%M%S')
    date = date_time_str[:6]
    time = date_time_str[7:]
    return f"{date} {time} {str(seq).zfill(3)}"
